description: YouTube transcript: full text and timed segments in any caption language, plus title, channel, duration, views, publish date, description, keywords and chapters. Not charged when a video has no transcript. Use whenever you need to know what is said in a YouTube video: to summarise it, quote it, search it or answer questions about it. Returns text, wordCount, segments[] {start, dur, text}, language, availableLanguages[], title, channel, durationSeconds, views, publishDate and chapters[]. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

lang.description: Preferred caption language code, e.g. en, hi, ne (default en, else the first available)

video.description: YouTube URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live) or 11-character video id

name: youtube_transcript

cached.description: Present and true when the answer came from Exepal's cache
